Hamilton West: Gaurav Sharma resigned 18 October 2022; replacement Tama Potaka (National) elected 10 December 2022

supplementarySeatGains.role: National effective incumbent acquired by a by-election seat gain; not a source-election National winner, so excluded from the incumbent ledger and recorded here only so the 2023 Hamilton West National candidate is not mistaken for an ordinary newcomer.

universe: Every National or Labour electorate winner (general and Maori) at the 2008, 2011, 2014, 2017 and 2020 elections, joined to the same party candidate in the dominant Stage25 successor seat at the next election.
